faqs.question: Q1. What is Aromatherapy Massage?
faqs.answer: Aromatherapy Massage is a therapeutic massage that uses natural essential oils to promote relaxation, reduce stress, relieve muscle tension, and improve overall well-being.

faqs.question: Q2. What are the benefits of Aromatherapy Massage?
faqs.answer: It helps with relaxation, pain management, and improved mood.

faqs.question: Q3. How long does a session last?
faqs.answer: Sessions typically last between 60 to 90 minutes depending on your preference.

faqs.question: Q4. Are there any side effects?
faqs.answer: Aromatherapy is generally safe, but some people may be sensitive to certain essential oils.

faqs.question: Q5. Do I need to book an appointment in advance?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend booking in advance to secure your preferred time.

faq.subtitle: FAQ
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our spa services, treatments, booking process, and more.

questions.q: Q1. What types of spa services do you offer?
questions.a: We offer a wide range of spa services including massage therapy, facial treatments, body care, aromatherapy, and wellness packages tailored to your needs. Each service is designed to help you relax, rejuvenate, and improve overall well-being.

questions.q: Q2. How do I book an appointment?
questions.a: You can book an appointment directly through our website by visiting the Book Appointment page, or you can call us at our phone number. Walk-ins are also welcome subject to availability.

questions.q: Q3. Do I need to bring anything for my spa session?
questions.a: Just bring yourself! We provide robes, slippers, and all necessary amenities. You may want to bring your swimsuit if you plan to use our hydrotherapy facilities.

questions.q: Q4. Are your spa products safe and natural?
questions.a: Yes, we use only high-quality, organic, and natural products that are safe for all skin types. If you have specific allergies, please inform us beforehand.

questions.q: Q5. How long does a typical spa session last?
questions.a: A typical session lasts anywhere from 60 to 90 minutes depending on the treatment you choose. We recommend arriving 15 minutes early.

questions.q: Q6. Can I customize a spa package?
questions.a: Absolutely! We offer customized packages. Please speak with our spa coordinators to create a package that perfectly suits your preferences.

questions.q: Q7. Do you offer packages for special occasions?
questions.a: Yes, we have special packages for birthdays, anniversaries, and bridal parties. Contact us for group bookings and special arrangements.

questions.q: Q8. What is your cancellation or rescheduling policy?
questions.a: We request a minimum of 24 hours notice for any cancellations or rescheduling. Late cancellations may incur a fee.
